transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I've been feeling really unsafe because I'm convinced that there are people monitoring me and trying to cause me harm. It feels like everyday events and things people say are somehow directed specifically at me, and I just can't shake these thoughts.

Have you also had times when your mood was very high or irritable with lots of energy, or very depressed for days to weeks? If so, did these beliefs about being monitored happen only during those mood episodes, or even when your mood felt normal?

I've never had those times of high energy or elevated moods, but I have felt deeply depressed for about eight months. The beliefs about being monitored definitely happen while I'm depressed, but they have also lasted for at least a couple of weeks during times when my mood felt relatively normal.

During those eight months of feeling depressed, did you also have symptoms like loss of interest, changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, guilt or worthlessness, poor concentration, or thoughts of death or suicide? About how many of these were present most days?

Yes, I struggled a lot with my appetite, constantly fluctuating between eating too much and not at all, which made my weight go up and down. My concentration was also terrible almost every day, and my thinking felt very clouded and dazed. I didn't really experience low energy, feelings of guilt, or thoughts of suicide, though.
During that eight-month period, were you feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day, and did you lose interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, during those eight months, I felt persistently depressed, sad, and empty almost every single day. I also completely lost interest in everything and couldn't find any pleasure in the activities I used to enjoy.

To be clear, was there a period of at least two full weeks when these beliefs that people were monitoring you were present while you were not depressed at all? During that time, did the depression symptoms like sadness or loss of interest fully go away?

Yes, there was a period of about two to three weeks where my sadness and lack of interest completely went away, and I felt emotionally normal. Even though the depression had lifted, I still felt just as strongly during that time that I was being watched and monitored.
Over the whole time you've been having these beliefs, would you say you were depressed for most of that illness, or were the depressed periods only a smaller part of it?

Yes, I would say I've been depressed for the majority of the time I've been dealing with this. The heavy, dark feelings have definitely been present for most of the overall period, even if there were brief times when the mood lifted slightly.

Crucially, the psychotic symptoms also persisted for 2–3 weeks when mood symptoms had fully remitted, and depressive symptoms were present for the majority of the illness duration, supporting schizoaffective disorder depressive type over schizophrenia.
